name: Evidently
summary: Open-source Python framework to evaluate, test and monitor ML and LLM systems, with 100+ built-in metrics, LLM judges, test suites for CI and a monitoring UI.
description: Reports compute data, ML and LLM quality evals (classification to RAG, text descriptors such as sentiment, length or denial detection, and LLM-as-a-judge); any Report becomes a Test Suite by adding pass/fail conditions, which suits regression testing and CI/CD checks. The monitoring UI can be self-hosted or used through Evidently Cloud, which Evidently says has a free tier plus extra features such as dataset and user management, alerting and no-code evals. Install with `pip install evidently`.
